title: ELISA Protocols for Cytokines
author: Marcia Guimaraes da Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdggi3tw

steps.title: IL-1β ELISA
steps.instruction: Perform the IL‑1β DuoSet ELISA on a 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of capture antibody (work concentration 4 µg/mL) to each well. Prepare the working solution by diluting 50 µL of the 800 µg/mL capture‑antibody stock (contains 40 µg) into 10 mL carbonate‑bicarbonate buffer.
Incubate the plate overnight in a wet chamber at 4 °C.
Wash the plate three times with 250 µL per well of PBS‑T.
Block with 200 µL per well of PBS‑T containing 5 % skimmed milk powder.
Incubate 3 h at room temperature.
Wash the plate three times with PBS‑T.

Prepare the standard curve: dilute 25 µL of recombinant IL‑1β (stock 2500 pg/mL) into 225 µL Reagent Diluent (1 % BSA‑PBS) to obtain 250 pg/mL. Add 100 µL of this standard to wells 1 and 2. Add 100 µL of Reagent Diluent to wells 2–8 and perform serial dilutions from well 2 to the last well.
Add 100 µL of each sample to the appropriate wells.
Incubate 3 h at room temperature.
Wash the plate three times with PBS‑T.
Add 100 µL of detection antibody (work concentration 200 ng/mL). Prepare by diluting 50 µL of the 40 µg/mL detection‑antibody stock (contains 2 µg) into 10 mL Reagent Diluent.
Incubate 2 h at room temperature.
Wash the plate three times with PBS‑T.
Add 100 µL of Streptavidin diluted 1:200.
Incubate in a dark chamber for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash the plate three times with PBS‑T.
Add 100 µL of substrate: 1 tablet of SigmaFast OPD, 1 buffer, and 20 µL distilled water (prepare enough for two plates).
Incubate in a dark chamber for 20 min at room temperature.
Add 50 µL of 2 N H₂SO₄ to stop the reaction.
Read absorbance at 492 nm using an Epoch plate reader (Epoch‑BioTek, Winooski, VT, USA).
